Oil Prices Surge Amid Houthi Attacks and Geopolitical Tensions

Oil prices increased by 2% following attacks by Houthi militants, which have raised concerns about supply disruptions. The situation is further complicated by fears of escalation between the U.S. and Iran. These events have contributed to a jump in oil prices.
